_comment: Published ceilings for the Ward agent on a five-year-old office PC (2 cores, 8 GB RAM, SATA SSD). Enforced by PerfTests in tests/test_setup_coverage_perf.py. The reference build is Python; the native agent must meet the same numbers on the same trace.

assumptions.note: Measured on a 4-core cloud VM; slow_machine_factor 2.0 models a 2-core five-year-old PC until a real-hardware CI lane exists. CPU = agent overhead (hooked minus unhooked identical operations). Added latency p99 includes first-capture journal copies. Median of 3 runs. The reference build is Python; the native agent must meet the same trace.

windows_native_service._comment: Targets for the resident Windows client (docs/25). Not met by the Python reference by design; a native build must report measurements that pass sensor.check_budget.
